name: Tailor
long_description:
Tailor is the headless ERP that gives fast-growing retail brands a composable, API-first platform to run operations with speed, flexibility, and control.

🧱 Legacy ERP is too rigid: Systems like NetSuite and SAP take months (or years) to implement and break with every change. Tailor is modular, headless, and easy to adapt.
🧩 Point solutions don’t scale: Tools like inventory or order management software solve one problem, but can’t talk to each other or keep up with growth.
📊 Spreadsheets are everywhere: From demand planning to purchase orders, even $100M+ brands still rely on Excel. Tailor replaces duct-taped workflows with ops modules you can tweak, combine, or scale
⚡️ Complex workflows need custom logic: Whether it's multi-location inventory, DTC + B2B orders, or light manufacturing (like kitting or lot tracking), Tailor supports flexible automations out of the box.
👟 Operators can move faster: Launch backend modules in minutes, not months. Tailor's low-code tools let teams build, automate, and adapt without waiting on engineering or implementation agencies.


Built for composable retail:
- Headless backend with GraphQL APIs
- 50+ integrations (Shopify, QuickBooks, 3PLs, etc.)
- Custom automations via Pipelines, Functions, and Event Triggers
- State machines for approvals and multi-step workflows
- AI features like OCR and vector search built in

Tailor is already powering operations at fast-growing omnichannel brands and modern manufacturers.
We’re proud to be the first Japan-based company to join Y Combinator. 

Learn more at [tailor.tech](https://www.tailor.tech)

launches.title: Tailor Omakase: Curated, Headless ERP for Fast-Growing Retail Brands
launches.tagline: 🛍️We help fast-growing retail brands replace rigid legacy systems, brittle point solutions and spreadsheet hell
launches.body:
Hello YC from Yo, Misato, and the team at Tailor 👋 We built Tailor as the headless ERP to replace monolithic, legacy tools — and today we’re launching Tailor Omakase. 

# **TL;DR**

Tailor Omakase is an opinionated, lightning-fast “ERP lite” for retail operators tired of rigid legacy systems, brittle point solutions and spreadsheet hell. 

See how it works in this demo: [**https://youtu.be/tzSZw3MEIk0?feature=shared**](https://youtu.be/tzSZw3MEIk0?feature=shared)

### **❌ The Problem: Retail ops software is stuck in the 90s**

Legacy ERP software (think Netsuite and SAP) is rigid, monolithic, and difficult to implement and customize. This hits **retail operations** especially hard because of the industry’s unique operational makeup of supply chains, online marketplaces, and varying sales channels. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91217&key=user_uploads/965414/c28e51ee-4b3f-4f22-80b3-8ac011720893)

Retail operators basically must choose between:

* **Legacy ERP**: Bulky, monolithic systems that take several months or years to implement.
* **Point solutions that don’t scale**: Tools for inventory, order management, or light manufacturing can solve short-term pain but aren’t API-first and break easily ops need to scale.
* **Spreadsheets or homegrown**: Even fast-growing brands run core ops on Google Sheets, Airtable, or in-house tools held together by duct tape.

 

### **✅ The Solution: Tailor Omakase**

**Tailor Omakase** is a curated, customizable ERP lite built for fast-growing retail brands. It helps operations teams manage purchasing, inventory, and orders across DTC, wholesale, and 3PL — without needing a full-time ERP admin, multi-year contracts, or expensive agency support.

[Product Demo](https://youtu.be/tzSZw3MEIk0)

🟣 **Fast to deploy:** Launch your first module in weeks — not months or years — with preconfigured views for purchasing, inventory, and order workflows 

🟣 **API-first & low-code:** Seamlessly integrate with any tool like Shopify or ShipStation, or easily build custom modules.

🟣 **Flexible**: Don’t change your operations to accommodate your software. Whether you're juggling DTC + wholesale orders or creating products in-house, Tailor’s modular and headless architecture adapts to you.

🟣 **Modern UI**: An intuitive frontend that ops teams love to use, plus the flexibility to ship beautiful customer-facing experiences 

**HubSpot** filled a gap for SMBs who couldn’t compete with **marketing** from enterprise giants using enterprise tools and budgets. **Tailor Omakase** does the same for **retail and ecommerce brands** when it comes to **operations**.

### **🔧 What’s under the hood**

Tailor Omakase runs on the same powerful [platform](https://www.tailor.tech/platform) we use to build internal tools and custom workflows for global enterprises.

* **Instant CRUD APIs**: Generate GraphQL/REST APIs from schema definitions in seconds, complete with validation, filtering, pagination, and relationships.
* **Composable backend**: Launch headless apps with custom logic, workflows, and event triggers without writing boilerplate code.
* **50+ pre-built integrations**: Seamlessly connect to Shopify, QuickBooks, 3PLs, and more using Tailor’s API-first architecture.
* **Automation-ready**: Use Pipelines, Functions, and Event Triggers to automate business logic and cross-system workflows.
* **State machine support**: Handle complex approval flows and record-level transitions using schema-defined states.
* **AI-native tools**: Enable vector search, parse documents with OCR, and integrate LLMs from OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models like Llama.
* **_Coming soon —_** **_Fabrix_**: Auto-generate UI components from GraphQL schemas using Tailor’s open-source framework, Fabrix

### **🏅 Our early customers**

* A strategic textile supplier to a $20B+ global clothing retailer
* A Japan-based hospitality company generating nearly $1B in annual revenue
* A custom jewelry company growing sales across Shopify, Pinterest, Etsy, TikTok and Amazon

### **🙏 Asks**

Know a **retail brand** trying to scale operations and growth? Send them our way at [yo@tailor.tech](mailto:yo@tailor.tech) or [patrick@tailor.tech](mailto:patrick@tailor.tech), share this post or book a demo [here](https://www.tailor.tech/demo)!

🎁 We’re offering Tailor Omakase **free for the first year** (core modules) to any company that mentions they heard about us from YC.

Tailor Omakase is especially helpful for:

* Companies **managing inventory** and orders in spreadsheets or Airtable
* **Shopify** stores selling both DTC and wholesale/B2B
* **Light manufacturing** or **kitting** **operations** (think skincare, make-up, customizable apparel/jewelry, made-to-order products)
* Teams using **QuickBooks** that need better financial visibility into COGS, PO, or inventory
